title: AFNI Seg

bias_classes.desc: A semicolon delimited string of classes that contribute to the estimation of the bias field

bias_fwhm.desc: The amount of blurring used when estimating the field bias with the Wells method

blur_meth.desc: set the blurring method for bias field estimation

bmrf.desc: Weighting factor controlling spatial homogeneity of the classifications

classes.desc: CLASS_STRING is a semicolon delimited string of class labels

in_file.desc: ANAT is the volume to segment

mask.desc: only non-zero voxels in mask are analyzed. mask can either be a dataset or the string "AUTO" which would use AFNI's automask function to create the mask.

mixfloor.desc: Set the minimum value for any class's mixing fraction

mixfrac.desc: MIXFRAC sets up the volume-wide (within mask) tissue fractions while initializing the segmentation (see IGNORE for exception)

prefix.desc: the prefix for the output folder containing all output volumes

description: 3dSeg segments brain volumes into tissue classes. The program allows
